title: Himachal Pradesh HC sets aside removal of ITBP constable forced to have sex with senior’s wife
description: The Himachal Pradesh High Court on Friday granted relief to a constable of the Indo-Tibetan Border Force (ITBP) who was removed from service in 2010 for developing a sexual relationship with the wife of an Assistant Commandant.A Division Bench of Chief Justice Gurmeet Singh Sandhawalia and Justice Bipin Chander Negi substituted the punishment with a penalty of compulsory retirement and all consequential benefits.The Court ruled that the constable could not have been removed from service when his
